templates.name: go2-rc
templates.description: Remote-control the Unitree Go2 EDU from a browser: a 3-service app group (motion API + camera stream + teleop web UI)
templates.requirements: A Unitree Go2 EDU and robot network

templates.name: g1-rc
templates.description: Remote-control the Unitree G1 humanoid from a browser: a 3-service app group (motion API + camera stream + teleop web UI) with posture, gesture, and arm-preset controls
templates.requirements: A Unitree G1 and supported camera

templates.name: go2-initial-test
templates.description: Pre-hackathon hardware self-test for the Unitree Go2: one tiny app per hardware interface (camera, LiDAR, mic, speaker, IMU, foot contact, battery, motion, GPU, Bluetooth, cloud) plus a dashboard UI showing a live pass/fail go/no-go board
templates.requirements: A Unitree Go2 EDU; large multi-service deployment

templates.name: go2-foxglove
templates.description: Stream a Unitree Go2 into Foxglove: LiDAR point cloud, pose+TF, body state and UWB over one WebSocket, plus the front camera (WebRTC). Ships a ready-made Foxglove layout.
templates.requirements: A Unitree Go2 EDU and Foxglove

templates.name: rc-car
templates.description: Remote-control a Yahboom ROSMASTER R2 (Ackerman) robot car from a browser: a 3-service app group (Rosmaster motion + UVC camera + teleop web UI)
templates.requirements: A Yahboom ROSMASTER R2, serial controller, and camera

templates.name: go2-rosbag
templates.description: Record a Unitree Go2's DDS topics to an mcap rosbag from a browser: discovers every topic the robot exposes and records all of them (opens directly in Foxglove / plays with ros2 bag)
templates.requirements: A Unitree Go2 EDU and persistent storage

templates.name: ros2-talker-listener
templates.description: ROS 2 talker/listener demo (over CycloneDDS): std_msgs/String publisher + subscriber as a two-service app group

templates.name: gpu-hello
templates.description: Pure-Mojo GPU diagnostics: verified vector-add + matmul kernels on the device GPU (Jetson sm_87/sm_110), report served over HTTP

templates.description: Camera, audio, GPU, and persistent SQLite demos in a React dashboard
